description: Find any app's id: by name or developer (the top matches in that storefront, with publisher, category, rating and rating count), or from an App Store / Google Play link, a bare App Store id or a package name. Use it before hive_app_details, hive_similar_apps or hive_app_reviews when you only have a name.

country.description: storefront code, e.g. us (defaults to us)

query.description: app name, developer name, store link, App Store id or package name

name: hive_search_apps
